description: This stunning two-story penthouse has been thoughtfully renovated throughout, offering 1,459 square feet of modern, turnkey living. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this top-floor residence showcases soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and only one shared wall—creating a rare sense of space, privacy, and tranquility. No detail has been overlooked. The home features brand new windows, fresh paint, a completely remodeled kitchen and bathrooms, all new appliances, and a new front door, delivering a clean, modern aesthetic and true move-in-ready experience. Step inside to a welcoming foyer that opens into a dramatic living and dining space, highlighted by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the home with natural light. The open-concept layout is ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. The redesigned kitchen combines style and functionality, featuring a built-in cooktop and brand-new appliances, creating a sleek and efficient culinary space. The main level includes a spacious primary suite, privately positioned at the end of the hallway, complete with an updated en-suite bathroom and generous closet space. A second full bathroom on this level offers added convenience for guests. Upstairs, a versatile loft-style bedroom with sliding doors provides flexibility for a guest room, home office, or creative studio. One of the home’s most exceptional features is the private rooftop patio—a rare outdoor retreat perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying warm Southern California evenings. Residents of the Racquet Club enjoy resort-style amenities including a tranquil koi pond, pool and spa, tennis courts, clubhouse, and secure gated underground parking. Ideally located in the heart of Encino, just moments from Ventura Boulevard’s top restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, this home offers the perfect blend of luxury, lifestyle, and convenience. A rare opportunity to own a fully remodeled, top-floor penthouse in one of Encino’s most desirable communities.
